title: Enumerate and Align
description:
1. Add a rank field in the begining of all list elements 
 2. "rank": 1 for the first row, "rank": 2 for the next one etc. 
 3. align the fields for all the elements
tips:
1. Select the list using x or mi[.
2. select { using s\{<enter> 
3. a to insert "rank:" after {
4. <ctrl-r># inserts numbers
5. Reselect all rows with x and align with s "<enter>& (aligns on starting quotes)
